captures.description: Green wall paint — previously misclassified as Yellow/Pale. Fixed by correcting TCS3530_RESP_X/Z constants and adding Muted Green calibration reference.
captures.notes: Root cause: old RESP_X=290/RESP_Z=250 left white RESP-norm unbalanced by 2.9% in X, biasing muted greens warm. Corrected to RESP_X=298.3/RESP_Z=238.1 from committed white ref (X=21259521 Y=21382400 Z=16971520). Theoretical D65 Lab from white-normalised reflectance: L=80.2 a*=-6.86 b*=14.29 (hue=116°); pipeline achieves a*≈-4.1 after calibration. Regression guard: category=Green must hold.
